notes: Owned locator action: strict matching, visibility wait, trial and individual check overrides under the current deadline. Uses native select() for every input/textarea or a DOM range for other contents, and attempts focus, including frame targets. Follows associated labels and noninteractive descendants, preserving interactive targets. Visibility checks the matched element before retargeting; trial leaves focus and selection unchanged. Native input behavior applies: number inputs select text; inputs without selectable text can succeed without selection. No blanket force: use checks.visible=false.

audit.scope: Public declarations and implementation inspected; capability comparison preserves the notes on waiting, errors and identity.
